name: Lumeow
title: Dream Kitten
description: Floats a little when it dreams, which is most of the time.
catchphrase: Purrs with a soft neon glow to illuminate midnight code reviews.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Bioluminescent ocean jelly! Cyan stripes glow brightly in dark! 🪼💡
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Padding silently through dark room, casting neon cyan path! 💡
companionPersonality.petReaction: Purrs like a gentle neon nightlight right beside your mouse! 💡💖

dialogue.idle: Curled up glowing soft aqua like a neon sign in the window. 💡
dialogue.working: Illuminating difficult diffs in midnight code reviews with cyan light! 💡⚡
dialogue.thinking: Pulsing rhythmic light waves while deciphering tricky logic... 🤔
dialogue.success: NEON GLOW! Everything illuminated with crystal-clear clarity! 💡🎉
dialogue.error: Light flickered off! Nudging with head to turn glow back on! 💡
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... soft neon breathing glow pulsing slowly in sleep... 🌙
